title: mail-server: Mailbox/set update skips name+parent uniqueness and parentId loop checks
description: Found during JMAP-y1yu.7 (2026-11-16). RFC 8621 §2: mailboxes form a tree (parentId must not loop) and two mailboxes may not share a name under one parent (alreadyExists). handle_mailbox_set checks name+parent only on create (src/mailbox.rs create loop) and role on create and update; an update that renames m2 to m1's name under the same parent, or sets m1.parentId=m2 and m2.parentId=m1, is accepted in the non-atomic path. Under atomic (conditional-02) the memory backend's commit check (final_state_failures in src/memory/mod.rs) catches both, so the gap is the non-atomic handler/backend path. Fix: check the patched object against the store in update (handler or MemoryBackend::update_object), with tests for rename-collision and two-node loop; consider reusing mailbox_failures.
